s1.syndrome_frame: Multiple bluish, partially keratotic skin lesions with slow growth, associated with bleeding after trauma, and found in conjunction with other systemic and familial factors
salient_findings: Multiple bluish, partially keratotic papules and nodules on the lower legs
key_facts: Patient is a female in her early 50s
Lesions have been growing slowly since age 24
Lesions bleed occasionally after trauma
Patient uses a wheelchair due to right-sided hemiparesis and hemianopsia
Hemiparesis and hemianopsia caused by an intracranial hemorrhage
Patient had recurrent seizures at age 4
Lipolymphedema of the lower legs attributed to functional venous insufficiency
Patient has been wearing compression stockings for years
Family history of similar conditions in the patient's father and aunt
Father died of an intracranial hemorrhage in his early 70s
Sonography demonstrated intradermal slow-flow vascular malformations
Histopathology revealed a well-circumscribed lesion with hyperkeratosis and acanthosis
Genetic testing detected a heterozygous pathogenic KRIT1 variant

raw.syndrome_frame: Multiple bluish, partially keratotic skin lesions with slow growth, associated with bleeding after trauma, and found in conjunction with other systemic and familial factors
salient_findings: Multiple bluish, partially keratotic papules and nodules on the lower legs
key_facts: Patient is a female in her early 50s
Lesions have been growing slowly since age 24
Lesions bleed occasionally after trauma
Patient uses a wheelchair due to right-sided hemiparesis and hemianopsia
Hemiparesis and hemianopsia caused by an intracranial hemorrhage
Patient had recurrent seizures at age 4
Lipolymphedema of the lower legs attributed to functional venous insufficiency
Patient has been wearing compression stockings for years
Family history of similar conditions in the patient's father and aunt
Father died of an intracranial hemorrhage in his early 70s
Sonography demonstrated intradermal slow-flow vascular malformations
Histopathology revealed a well-circumscribed lesion with hyperkeratosis and acanthosis
Genetic testing detected a heterozygous pathogenic KRIT1 variant

raw.rationale: The presence of bluish, partially keratotic papules and nodules on the lower legs, along with sonography demonstrating intradermal slow-flow vascular malformations and histopathology revealing a well-circumscribed lesion with hyperkeratosis and acanthosis overlying dilated venous-like malformations, is consistent with glomus tumors. Additionally, the detection of a heterozygous pathogenic KRIT1 variant, which is associated with cerebral cavernous malformations, supports this diagnosis given the patient's history of intracranial hemorrhage and family history of similar conditions.

rejected.label: hemiparesis
rejected.why: Hemiparesis is a symptom, not a diagnosis that explains the skin lesions.

rejected.label: punctate porokeratosis
rejected.why: The clinical and histopathological findings do not match punctate porokeratosis.

rejected.label: purpura
rejected.why: Purpura refers to purple discolorations due to bleeding under the skin, which does not explain the papules and nodules.

rejected.label: dermatitis
rejected.why: Dermatitis is a general term for skin inflammation, which does not specifically explain the patient's lesions or the genetic findings.
